verdict.rationale: Docs confirm DNS record CRUD via API for domains on GoDaddy nameservers (godaddy-docs-4/19), but nothing documents support for 'every record type' or low TTL configuration specifically, and multiple independent hands-on reports describe the domain/DNS management UI as slow and cumbersome rather than developer-friendly (godaddy-comm-7, godaddy-comm-5, godaddy-comm-9), directly contradicting the 'UI that doesn't fight me' part of the story. missing for 10: explicit list of supported record types, TTL control specifics, and any positive independent review of the DNS management UI's usability.
